findings.claim: Check returns a denial immediately from permDenialCache but ignores denials in the permission cache so that new grants are picked up. Once a denial is stored in permDenialCache, any permission granted afterward is blocked for up to the cache TTL.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:116-121, Check immediately returns Allowed: false on a permDenialCache hit before consulting permCache or the database, whereas lines 123-136 ignore denials in permCache so new grants fall through to getIdentityPermissions. Because denials are written to permDenialCache at pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:153-155 with shortCacheTTL (30s, lines 31 and 85) and never invalidated, any permission granted afterward for that key is blocked until the TTL expires.

findings.claim: TestService_getUserPermissions no longer has a cacheHit:true case, so the cacheHit field and both 'if tc.cacheHit' branches are dead. No test asserts the always-go-to-store behavior or the removed anonymous cache read.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/authz/rbac/service_test.go:333-395, TestService_getUserPermissions only has cacheHit:false cases (lines 341-356), leaving the cacheHit field (line 337) and both 'if tc.cacheHit' branches (lines 367-369 and 388-390) dead. No test directly asserts that getUserPermissions (pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:370-417) always queries the store when permCache is populated or tests the removed cache read in getAnonymousPermissions (pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:419-439); TestService_CacheCheck (pkg/services/authz/rbac/service_test.go:947-972) only indirectly exercises user Check fallback on an outdated cache without asserting store calls or covering anonymous permissions.

findings.claim: The newly added log message 'could not check permission' starts with a lowercase letter, which violates the convention that messages start with a capital letter.

verifier.reason: Although pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:127 logs "could not check permission" in lowercase, there is no convention requiring capitalized log messages in contribute/backend/style-guide.md or .golangci.yml. Every log message in pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go (including the identical pre-existing message at pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:148 and lines 102, 141, 168, 188) and pkg/services/authz/rbac/cache.go starts with a lowercase letter, so the new line follows the package's existing convention.
